ops.title: Reduce monorepo cc-notes status latency and attribute pack growth
ops.description: Owner root. User reports status 0.1s in CCN repo vs5.5s monorepo and suspects many fetch-created packs. One authorized actual status read on installed0.76.10 took2.19s, maxRSS392806400 bytes, with Git object-batch lifetime1.613882s; that child lifetime is not exclusive CPU attribution. Explicit pack-directory inventory:4041 .pack,4041 .idx,3623 .promisor,3638 .rev. Initial GIT_TRACE_PERFORMANCE=1 diagnostic altered expected empty stderr on missing-config exit1; retry directed trace to a named file, no persistent config changes. Status uses compact metadata plus exposed task/run snapshots and note/doc/answer ancestry. Next: attribute object batches and review classifiers, inspect bounded fetch configuration and native pack reads, isolate hosted regression before code changes. Evidence ccn277-monorepo-status.trace and ccn277-monorepo-git-performance.log in cost-retro-20261102.

ops.text: Identify concrete status work and fetch/pack growth source without assuming pack count proves causality
Confirmed optimization preserves complete status output, passes hosted regression and performance checks, ships and installs locally
